tests.name: test_country_grain_and_threshold
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT country) = 2 AND BOOL_AND(country IN ('US', 'CA')) AS ok FROM learner_result

tests.name: test_zero_conversion_country_is_kept
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT country, signups_2026, converted_users, ROUND(conversion_rate::DOUBLE, 6), ROUND(paid_search_signup_share::DOUBLE, 6) FROM learner_result WHERE country = 'CA'), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, ROUND(e3::DOUBLE, 6), ROUND(e4::DOUBLE, 6) FROM (VALUES ('CA', 100, 0, 0.0, 0.1)) v(e0, e1, e2, e3, e4)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok

tests.name: test_signups_restricted_to_2026
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AND MIN(signups_2026) = 120 AND abs(MIN(paid_search_signup_share) - 0.25) < 1e-9 AS ok FROM learner_result WHERE country = 'US'

tests.name: test_converted_users_are_distinct_2026_signups_with_paid_2026_orders
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AND MIN(converted_users) = 3 AND abs(MIN(conversion_rate) - 0.025) < 1e-9 AS ok FROM learner_result WHERE country = 'US'

tests.name: test_exact_result
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT country, signups_2026, converted_users, ROUND(conversion_rate::DOUBLE, 6), ROUND(paid_search_signup_share::DOUBLE, 6) FROM learner_result), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, ROUND(e3::DOUBLE, 6), ROUND(e4::DOUBLE, 6) FROM (VALUES ('US', 120, 3, 0.025, 0.25), ('CA', 100, 0, 0.0, 0.1)) v(e0, e1, e2, e3, e4)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok
